summary: Wevano is a machine builder in Emmeloord, the Netherlands, making sorting, grading, cleaning, inspection, storage, filling, emptying and conveying machines and complete lines for potatoes and other crops. It was founded in 2000 and does its engineering, construction and assembly at its own site. Its JW 1300 grader handles up to 25 tonnes per hour.
machines: U-Vision: camera sorter for size and defects, up to 11 tonnes per hour
JCL-1000: camera quality sorter making three output streams, up to 12 tonnes per hour
JW 1300: square-mesh grader with 5 screen decks, up to 25 tonnes per hour
PU Rollerset: roller set for soil removal, spreading and sorting
Kluitenscheider (clod separator): separates clods from potatoes, type 1 up to 6 tonnes per hour
Egelband (spiked belt): removes loose soil and haulm residue in the sorting line
Borstelmachine: brushing machine that cleans potatoes before inspection or sorting
Ontsmettingsset: stainless roller set for treating potatoes after the inspection table
Leestafel and leescabine: inspection table and insulated inspection cabin built to order
Doseerbunker: dosing bunker built to order for 3-4 up to 10-12 tonnes
facts: U-Vision camera sorter capacity up to 11 tonnes per hour
JCL-1000 sorter capacity up to 12 tonnes per hour, depending on the batch
JW 1300 grader capacity up to 25 tonnes per hour over 5 screen decks
